def classify(title, publisher):
    t = title
    if any(k in t for k in ["心理", "哲学", "思考", "静", "修养", "正念", "不生气"]):

    if any(k in t for k in ["科学", "自然", "天文", "数学", "物理", "生物", "实验", "星球", "恐龙", "昆虫"]):

def workdays_between(start, end):
    cur = start
    out = []
    while cur <= end:
        if is_workday(cur):
            out.append(cur)
        cur += timedelta(days=1)
    return out

def next_workday(d):
    while not is_workday(d):
        d += timedelta(days=1)
    return d

def add_months_approx(d, days=30):

def pick_return(borrow, due):

    hi = min(due - timedelta(days=1), borrow + timedelta(days=28))
    if hi < lo:

    candidates = workdays_between(lo, hi)

def generate_records(sem, seed_offset):
    rng = random.Random(20260921 + seed_offset)
    days = workdays_between(sem["start"], sem["end"])
    # pick ~18-24 borrowing activity days clustered
    n_days = rng.randint(18, 24)
    # prefer Tue/Wed/Thu
    preferred = [d for d in days if d.weekday() in (1, 2, 3)]
    if len(preferred) < n_days:

    records = []
    for name, bdate, n_books in visits:
        due = add_months_approx(bdate, 30)
        # due date itself can fall on weekend; sample keeps calendar +30, so keep as is
        ret = pick_return(bdate, due)
        # ensure return is still a workday and not after semester end much
        if ret > sem["end"] + timedelta(days=20):
            ret = pick_return(bdate, min(due, sem["end"] + timedelta(days=15)))

        # choose books: mix list + edu
        chosen = []
        for _ in range(n_books):
            if rng.random() < 0.22:
                title, pub, cat = rng.choice(edu_books)
                book = {"title": title, "publisher": pub, "category": cat}
            else:
                book = rng.choice(books)
            # avoid same teacher same day same title
            key = (name, bdate, book["title"])
            tries = 0
            while key in used_titles_global and tries < 20:
                book = rng.choice(books)
                key = (name, bdate, book["title"])
                tries += 1
            used_titles_global.add(key)
            chosen.append(book)

        for book in chosen:
            records.append({
                "op": "已还",
                "title": book["title"],
                "barcode": next_barcode(),
                "reader_id": reader_ids[name],
                "borrow": bdate.isoformat(),
                "due": due.isoformat(),
                "return": ret.isoformat(),
                "operator": "gly",
                "name": name,
                "publisher": book["publisher"],
                "dept": "教师",
                "category": book["category"],
                "qty": 1,
                "status": "完好",
            })
    return records

def write_workbook(sem, records, out_path):
    wb = Workbook()
    # --- detail ---
    ws = wb.active
    ws.title = "教师借阅明细"
    ws.merge_cells("A1:N1")
    ws.merge_cells("A2:B2")
    ws.merge_cells("K2:N2")
    ws["A1"] = "凤凰双语教育集团教师借阅登记表"
    ws["A1"].font = font_title
    ws["A1"].alignment = align_c
    ws["A2"] = f"学期： {sem['label']}"
    ws["A2"].font = font_sub
    ws["A2"].alignment = Alignment(horizontal="left", vertical="center")
    ws["K2"] = "图书管理员："
    ws["K2"].font = font_sub
    ws["K2"].alignment = Alignment(horizontal="left", vertical="center")
    ws.row_dimensions[1].height = 44
    ws.row_dimensions[2].height = 35
    ws.row_dimensions[3].height = 30

    for i, h in enumerate(HEADERS, 1):
        cell = ws.cell(3, i, h)
        cell.font = font_header
        cell.alignment = align_c
        cell.border = thin

    for r_i, rec in enumerate(records, 4):
        vals = [
            rec["op"], rec["title"], rec["barcode"], rec["reader_id"],
            rec["borrow"], rec["due"], rec["return"], rec["operator"],
            rec["name"], rec["publisher"], rec["dept"], rec["category"],
            rec["qty"], rec["status"],
        ]
        for c_i, v in enumerate(vals, 1):
            cell = ws.cell(r_i, c_i, v)
            cell.font = font_cell
            cell.alignment = align_c if c_i != 2 else align_l
            cell.border = thin
        ws.row_dimensions[r_i].height = 22

    for col, w in COL_WIDTHS.items():
        ws.column_dimensions[col].width = w

    last = 3 + len(records)
    ws.auto_filter.ref = f"A3:N{last}"
    ws.freeze_panes = "A4"

    # --- summary by reader ---
    ws2 = wb.create_sheet("教师借阅汇总")
    sum_headers = ["读者证号", "读者姓名", "借阅册数", "已还册数", "在借册数", "完好册数", "破损册数"]
    for i, h in enumerate(sum_headers, 1):
        cell = ws2.cell(1, i, h)
        cell.font = font_header
        cell.alignment = align_c
        cell.border = thin

    by_reader = defaultdict(list)
    for rec in records:
        by_reader[(rec["reader_id"], rec["name"])].append(rec)

    row = 2
    for (rid, name), recs in sorted(by_reader.items(), key=lambda x: x[0][0]):
        n = len(recs)
        returned = sum(1 for r in recs if r["op"] == "已还")
        intact = sum(1 for r in recs if r["status"] == "完好")
        damaged = n - intact
        vals = [rid, name, n, returned, n - returned, intact, damaged]
        for i, v in enumerate(vals, 1):
            cell = ws2.cell(row, i, v)
            cell.font = font_cell
            cell.alignment = align_c
            cell.border = thin
        row += 1
    for i, w in enumerate([12, 12, 10, 10, 10, 10, 10], 1):
        ws2.column_dimensions[get_column_letter(i)].width = w

    # --- category summary ---
    ws3 = wb.create_sheet("类别汇总")
    cat_headers = ["图书类别", "借阅册数", "涉及教师数"]
    for i, h in enumerate(cat_headers, 1):
        cell = ws3.cell(1, i, h)
        cell.font = font_header
        cell.alignment = align_c
        cell.border = thin
    cat_books = Counter()
    cat_teachers = defaultdict(set)
    for rec in records:
        cat_books[rec["category"]] += 1
        cat_teachers[rec["category"]].add(rec["name"])
    # order similar to sample
    order = ["哲学", "社会科学", "人文社科", "自然科学"]
    cats = [c for c in order if c in cat_books] + [c for c in cat_books if c not in order]
    r = 2
    for c in cats:
        vals = [c, cat_books[c], len(cat_teachers[c])]
        for i, v in enumerate(vals, 1):
            cell = ws3.cell(r, i, v)
            cell.font = font_cell
            cell.alignment = align_c
            cell.border = thin
        r += 1
    for i, w in enumerate([14, 10, 12], 1):
        ws3.column_dimensions[get_column_letter(i)].width = w

    wb.save(out_path)
    return len(records), len(by_reader)

import os
outdir = "/Users/mac/Downloads/二校区教师借阅记录_三年"
os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)

summary = []
for i, sem in enumerate(SEMESTERS):
    recs = generate_records(sem, seed_offset=i * 17)
    path = os.path.join(outdir, sem["file"])
    n_rec, n_tea = write_workbook(sem, recs, path)

    assert all(r["op"] == "已还" for r in recs)
    visits = defaultdict(int)
    for r in recs:
        visits[(r["name"], r["borrow"])] += 1
    assert max(visits.values()) <= 5
    # check borrow dates are workdays
    bad = [r for r in recs if not is_workday(date.fromisoformat(r["borrow"]))]
    bad_ret = [r for r in recs if not is_workday(date.fromisoformat(r["return"]))]
    print(f"{sem['label']}: rows={n_rec}, teachers={n_tea}, max/visit={max(visits.values())}, bad_borrow={len(bad)}, bad_return={len(bad_ret)} -> {path}")
    summary.append((sem["label"], n_rec, n_tea, path))

print("\nDONE")
for s in summary:
    print(s)
